title: Ethiopian Lamb Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy dish featuring juicy lamb marinated in traditional Ethiopian spices, grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together berbere spice, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the marinade and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb is cooked through to an internal temperature of 145°F.
Transfer skewers to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and parsley.
